title: Pride before a fall
literal_meaning: Through excessive pride, Lanka was destroyed.
explanation: The source invokes Ravana’s downfall as an image of destructive pride. It warns against arrogance through a literary-religious allusion, not a verified historical event.
meaning_odia: ରାବଣଙ୍କ ପତନର ସାହିତ୍ୟିକ ଓ ଧାର୍ମିକ କାହାଣୀକୁ ଅତି ଗର୍ବର ଉଦାହରଣ କରାଯାଇଛି। ନିଜ ଶକ୍ତି ଉପରେ ଅତ୍ୟଧିକ ଭରସା କରି ସୀମା ଭୁଲିଗଲେ ବିପଦ ଆସିପାରେ। ବଡ଼ ନାଁର ଏହି ଉଲ୍ଲେଖ ଚେତାବନୀକୁ ଜୋର୍ ଦିଏ, ପ୍ରମାଣିତ ଐତିହାସିକ ଘଟଣାର ବିବରଣୀ ନୁହେଁ।
usage_example: A leader dismisses every warning and the plan fails. (Original editorial example, not a collected quotation.)
